The surplus claim has no actual-first-descent or selector premise; a downstream application must preserve the actual least strict descent, every original rank guard, current-p strict selectors, and original branch multiplicities r_i. No endpoint, selected-payment, MASS, arbitrary-tree, or Lean conclusion is included.
